contexts.label: Days Completed
contexts.calculation: Counts how many of the listed answers have a recorded value.
contexts.meaning: This is a response count, not a success rate. An available answer counts even when it records no action or no opportunity. Missing answers remain missing.

contexts.label: Shift
contexts.calculation: Habit Control Shift Index minus Habit Control Index (Pre).
contexts.meaning: The difference is in points on the original 1–10 rating scale. A positive value means the first rating is higher; zero means the ratings are equal; a negative value means it is lower. These are your own ratings, not an assessment of skill or proof of programme effect.

contexts.label: Days Completed
contexts.calculation: Counts how many of the listed answers have a recorded value.
contexts.meaning: This is a response count, not a success rate. An available answer counts even when it records no action or no opportunity. Missing answers remain missing.

contexts.label: Shift
contexts.calculation: Innovation Awareness Shift Index minus Innovation Awareness Index (Pre).
contexts.meaning: The difference is in points on the original 1–10 rating scale. A positive value means the first rating is higher; zero means the ratings are equal; a negative value means it is lower. These are your own ratings, not an assessment of skill or proof of programme effect.
